style_inspiration: DesignJoy-inspired layout, clean, conversion-focused, generous whitespace, warm minimalist.

accent_phrases.description: Used inline within Poppins headlines for emphasis, e.g., 'Hi, I\'m *Vance*' or 'Design that actually *ships*'.

usage.12px: Cards, pricing tiles, input fields, dropdown menus.
usage.24px: Larger feature tiles, prominent icon tile containers, bento grid blocks.

motion.philosophy: Intentional and restrained. Respects prefers-reduced-motion. No auto-playing loops, no elastic bounce.

hover_states.card: Lift/Translate-Y -2px to -4px, duration 200ms, subtle shadow increase.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF6B35] text-white rounded-full font-bold hover:brightness-95 transition-all duration-150 ease-out hover:scale-[1.02]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-[#FF6B35] text-[#FF6B35] rounded-full font-bold hover:bg-[#FF6B35]/10 transition-all duration-150 ease-out hover:scale-[1.02]

cards.feature_tile: bg-white rounded-[24px] border border-[#1A1A1A]/10 shadow-sm p-8

inputs.base: bg-white border border-[#1A1A1A]/20 rounded-[12px] px-4 py-3 text-[#1A1A1A] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#FF6B35] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FF6B35] transition-all tracking-[-0.03em]

status_pills.base: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-bold text-white

quotes.style: border-2 border-dashed border-[#1A1A1A]/20 p-6 rounded-[12px] italic text-[#8A8588]

layouts.navigation: Sticky top, blurred glassmorphism background (e.g., bg-[#F7F5F2]/80 backdrop-blur-md). Includes Logo left, Staff/Client portal buttons right.
layouts.hero: Centered heavy layout. 'Open Slots' live indicator pill at top. Massive headline mixing Poppins Bold and Lora Italic. Mascot PNG clustered near or interacting with CTA. Generous bottom padding.
layouts.portfolio_grid: Bento-style CSS grid (e.g., grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12). Mix of col-span-4, col-span-8 to create varying tile sizes. Filter tabs positioned above grid.
layouts.services_pricing: Grid of cards. Each card uses one of the 5 gradient icon tiles (lock, lightning, star, grid, board). White card background, icon top-left, punchy bold headline, plain sentence description.
layouts.how_it_works: Vertical timeline or 4-step horizontal track. Bold numbering.
layouts.faq: Clean accordion (Shadcn customized). Flat white blocks, 12px radius, accent-colored chevron on expand.
layouts.commission_form: Max-width container (max-w-2xl). Stacked inputs. Image upload dashed zone. Primary CTA at bottom.
layouts.footer: Simple, uncluttered. Copyright, links (Terms, Privacy, Discord, Robux disclaimer). 'Last updated' dynamic date on legal pages.
layouts.admin_login: Centered card on #F7F5F2 background. 24px radius card, minimalistic.
layouts.not_found_404: Playful, on-brand. Mascot presence. Bold '404' and friendly redirect to home.

system.gradient_icons: lock.png, lightning.png, star.png, grid.png, board.png (DO NOT BUILD IN CSS, use as image sources)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the fonts Poppins and Lora are loaded via Google Fonts or standard imports in index.css.
DO NOT use generic sans-serif for main titles, strictly use Poppins Bold.
For the Lora italic emphasis, explicitly wrap the word in a <span> with the Lora font family and italic styles.

The 5 gradient icon tiles (lock, lightning, star, grid, board) must be implemented via standard tags representing the uploaded assets. Do not recreate these with CSS gradients. All other gradients are forbidden.
Use solid #FF6B35 for all primary CTAs.
Apply `data-testid` to all interactive buttons, tabs, accordions, and form elements. Example: `data-testid="submit-commission-btn"`.
Form logic must use standard JS/React conventions (not .tsx).
Bento grid for the portfolio should break asymmetry. Example: A mix of wide (col-span-8) and square (col-span-4) tiles on desktop.
Header nav must have a solid or heavily blurred background to prevent text collision when scrolling. DO NOT use completely transparent headers.
Make sure hover states match exactly what is defined: slight scale up (1.02) and subtle shadow without aggressive bouncy transitions.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts (unless explicitly requested like Hero), simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate, like the sticky navbar.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container globally, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner components are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.js` (standard JS path).
